name: Van Halen I Brown
reference: Ain't Talkin' 'bout Love (~139 BPM) / Runnin' with the Devil (~96 BPM): Van Halen (1978, Sunset Sound, prod. Ted Templeman, eng. Donn Landee)
rig: Frankenstrat (one wax-potted PAF bridge humbucker, one volume knob) or Ibanez Destroyer (Runnin') -> stock 1968 Marshall 1959 Super Lead 100 W, everything on 10, mains lowered to ~89-90 V with a Variac, dummy load -> two basket-weave Marshall 4x12s (one G12M-25 Greenback, one JBL D120F), SM57s; Sunset Sound Studio 1 live echo chamber panned opposite the guitar
notes: Dual rig, same Variac'd plexi on both sides (the Slammin 1959HW at 180 V is 75% of its 240 V mains, i.e. EVH's documented 89-90 of 120 V). Left = G12M-25 Greenback 4x12 SM57, right = JBL E120 standing in for the documented JBL D120F cab. Landee panned the guitar to one side and the live chamber to the other: the 480L Large Chamber sits at 15% left and 40% right. SW8 BOOST = TS9 clean push (not on the record). SW9 DELAY = a generic 320 ms solo slap (the record has no tempo-synced delay). Phase 90 (Ain't Talkin', slow speed) and the electric-sitar double can't be modelled. Research: the 80s-tones.md shortlist (captures and model ids checked with `tone3000.py models`). On the board (bank 1): SW8 = BOOST (slot 1), SW9 = DELAY (slot 5 / R3). Levels are unmeasured.

left.label: Ibanez TS9 clean push, D0 T6 L10 (lead boost, not on the record)
Marshall 1959HW Plexi on a Variac, 180 V (= EVH's ~90 of 120 V), dimed 10
Lexicon 480L Large Chamber (Sunset Sound live chamber)

right.label: Marshall 1959HW Plexi on a Variac, 180 V (= EVH's ~90 of 120 V), dimed 10
Lexicon 480L Large Chamber, opposite side (Landee's panning)
